L05.question: Ridge regression adds one extra term to the least-squares loss. Which one?
options: λ · Σ |w|, the sum of the absolute weights (L1)
λ · Σ w², the sum of the squared weights (L2)
λ · (number of nonzero weights), counting what survives (L0)
